group_assessment.weighting: The multi-author review includes investigators who generated several summarized fragile-site models, including Wwox models. First-person phrasing reflects that provenance but does not make this review a new experiment. Claims are weighted as synthesis and do not inherit independent-replication status.

field_density.note: The broad common-fragile-site literature is dense and heterogeneous. The paper's value is historical comparison across genes, not novelty or an exhaustive modern WWOX census.

entries.proposition: The review interprets retained second alleles in heterozygous tumours as haploinsufficiency.
entries.snippet: in some tumors the second Wwox allele remained intact, suggesting haploinsufficiency for tumor suppression.

entries.proposition: The ENU comparison summarized 80% versus 40% tumour incidence.
entries.snippet: incidence of tumor formation in Wwox+/− mice was 80% compared to 40% in Wwox+/+ animals.

entries.proposition: The NMBA comparison summarized almost 100% versus 29% forestomach tumours.
entries.snippet: almost 100% of Wwox+/−mice had developed forestomach tumors ranging from adenomas to invasive carcinomas, whereas tumors were present only in 29% of Wwox+/+ animals.

entries.proposition: The global-null model is summarized as metabolic disease with death at 3–4 weeks.
entries.snippet: these mice exhibit a metabolic disorder characterized by hypoglycemia and hypocalcaemia and die at 3-4 weeks of age

entries.proposition: The 2011 review says the small global-null mice lacked observed abnormal behaviour or impaired motor skills.
entries.snippet: Though smaller in size, they did not display abnormal behavior or impaired motor skills

entries.proposition: The Runx2 causal chain is explicitly labelled speculation requiring further work.
entries.snippet: we speculated that absence of Wwox stimulates Runx2 transactivation function and hence upregulates its expression. Further investigations are however necessary

entries.proposition: Conditional Wwox models were presented as tools for future adult and tissue-specific work.
entries.snippet: This new model will greatly facilitate the functional analysis of Wwox in adult mice and will allow more refined investigations of neoplastic transformation in specific target tissues

entries.proposition: The proposed Fhit/Wwox compound comparison was a future experiment, not an observed result.
entries.snippet: we can ask what might be the outcome of exposing a potential FHIT−/−Wwox+/− mouse to such chemical insults when compared to single knockout animals.

entries.proposition: Figure 1 provides no visual evidence about WWOX.
entries.snippet: The three drawn schemes show Fhit−/− with Vhl+/−, Fhit+/− with MMTV-HER2, and Fhit+/− with Nit1−/−; no Wwox genotype or phenotype appears.
